messages:
Anita Ramos: Heads-up — several interviewers reported being double-booked for the same training slot. They see the same calendar time twice and the ATS shows two RSVP rows.
Leo Park: saw 4 reports this morning from recruiters. seems localized to CSV importer.
Maya Chen: I think it's the timezone header. ATS CSV import treats 'PST'/'PDT' as separate tokens when recruiters paste from Sheets, which can create duplicate registrations for different parsed offsets.
Dustin Ford: can you repro?
Maya Chen: yes. quick repro: export attendee list from ATS -> re-import -> duplicates appear if "timezone" column uses short names or freeform text. The importer creates a new attendee row instead of matching on email+session_id.
Anita Ramos: impact: interviewers get conflicting invites and sometimes miss trainings because they assume it's a duplicate. Need a fix before next cohort.
ops-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-622 — ats-csv-timezone-dup. Assigned to eng-infra.
Leo Park: short term: can we run a manual dedupe over today's imports and notify affected people?
Dustin Ford: I'll run a de-dup job and push a note to recruiters. Also adding a validation that normalizes timezone values to full IANA names (e.g., America/Los_Angeles) during import.
Maya Chen: propose fail-fast validation: if timezone column matches non-IANA pattern, show an import preview with an error and suggested replacement.
Anita Ramos: agree. Product: can we add an import preview that highlights duplicate identifiers (email + session_id) and flagged TZs?
ops-bot: Product request created: PRD-431 — csv-import-preview + tz-normalization.
Leo Park: immediate mitigation: I've emailed affected interviewers with corrected single calendar invite and removed duplicate rows from the ATS.
Dustin Ford: updating recruiter playbook: "When preparing CSVs, use full IANA timezones or leave the timezone column blank; avoid PST/PDT shorthand."
Anita Ramos: please also schedule a 15-min recruiter training on CSV best practices and record it for the ops library.
Maya Chen: I'll add it to this week's ops sync and upload recording to docs.
Anita Ramos: thanks everyone. Post here when the import validation is live so we can close INC-2026-622.
